info.title: Elevateo local session and mailbox contract
info.description: Canonical accepted BE-02A lifecycle amendment and unchanged FE-01 read checkpoint. Design contract, not implementation acceptance. All mail content is plaintext. See README.md for normative authorization, lifecycle, byte limits and transport rules.

get.description: Authenticate and check current session revocation before returning actor, organization, context and in-memory CSRF bootstrap token. Does not create or refresh a login. Does not list mailboxes; getMailboxes is the sole capability list. A valid cookie with no currently usable organization returns not_available.

parameters.name: filter

post.description: Exact Origin and challenge bound to the existing opaque session. A locally valid cookie with an expired access JWT may refresh; do not require the ordinary online-read precheck. Commit one durable claim, call Auth once, and CAS publish within the original ten-second request deadline. Contenders return 503 Retry-After 1. Uncertain/expired claim requires reauthentication; never steal/replay it or resurrect after logout. Context and CSRF remain stable. With no selected organization, explicit refresh may select a newly provisioned membership; otherwise keep the local cookie and return 404.

Commit local/default or all bound-user local/global revocation and durable upstream intent before Auth. Clear cookie even if Auth is down or access JWT expired. Global scope requires a locally valid bound user; an expired local session cannot perform global logout and returns 401.

GET has no body; only declared query keys are allowed. JSON maxLength counts Unicode code points. UUIDs are parsed and canonicalized before binding/digest comparison.

put.description: Complete durable save with current compose permission and session/context/Origin/CSRF. expected_version=0 creates version 1; positive expected_version must equal current version. After current scope/ownership checks, inspect the actor/org/operation unique ledger before draft version/state or reply-target checks: same binding and canonical digest returns the original applied result even after later save B or consumption; a recorded conflict replays its original 409. Different binding/digest or any expired ID gives 409 operation_mismatch. For a new operation, reply_to_thread_id must be null or a currently readable thread in this mailbox; consumed drafts give draft_consumed, then stale/missing versions give draft_conflict. No live send or consume endpoint. Save and terminal ledger record commit atomically; concurrent identical requests converge without incrementing twice. See docs/completion/be02-cd-contract.md for the exact digest and seven-day retention boundary.

get.description: Search only currently authorized plaintext thread subject and message body/sender/to display names and addresses; never drafts or notes. q is 1..256 Unicode code points, not solely whitespace, and otherwise preserved. Literal case-insensitive substring matching using parameterized PostgreSQL with %, _ and backslash escaped as literals; no SQL/regex/tsquery syntax from callers. Match a thread once if any authorized searchable field contains q; return its unchanged canonical ThreadSummary preview, not an HTML highlight or an extra excerpt. Optional mailbox must be currently readable or generic 404. Order last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC; at most 50/256 KiB, signed scoped cursor, whole entries, no totals. Existing database query only; indexes need representative EXPLAIN evidence. Search never returns threads in the spam or trash folders.

sessionCookie.name: elevateo_session
sessionCookie.description: Rails-managed opaque session; HttpOnly, host-only, Path=/, SameSite=Strict, Secure on HTTPS. No client token persistence.

challengeCookie.name: elevateo_challenge
challengeCookie.description: Five-minute signed HttpOnly challenge; CSRF proof must bind the current session and pending entry when present. Same cookie flags as session.

pendingEntryCookie.name: elevateo_pending
pendingEntryCookie.description: Ten-minute opaque HttpOnly entry handle. Stored encrypted token hash is never sent to JavaScript; pending entry grants no application access.

snoozed_until.description: While in the future the thread is hidden from the all/unread folders and listed under snoozed; it returns automatically once the time passes. Mailbox-shared.

starred.description: Actor-specific star; defaults false when no star row exists.

snoozed_until.description: While in the future the thread is hidden from the all/unread folders and listed under snoozed; it returns automatically once the time passes. Mailbox-shared.

starred.description: Actor-specific star; defaults false when no star row exists.

ResourceVersion.description: Server-owned monotonic revision. Zero means no prior version. Never wrap or reuse; exhaustion returns 503 before mutation.

CollaborationError.description: C/D error envelope only; unchanged A/B Error remains closed. At most 4096 serialized UTF-8 bytes; no mail body, subject, recipients, digest or foreign identity.

DraftSaveInput.description: Complete replacement, not a merge. All fields required; version 0 creates. Address is the unchanged canonical nullable Address so incomplete unsent recipients are valid. Empty subject/body/to are valid; no sending or attachment fields.

DraftSaveResult.description: Original applied result, including on an identical retry after another save or later consumption. Does not describe the current draft.

Draft.description: Actor-owned complete stored draft. No truncation; consumed is a terminal state reserved for BE-03, not a BE-02 action.

DraftSummary.description: First 256 subject code points with truthful truncation flag. No body or recipients. Includes own editable and consumed drafts.

DraftOperationApplied.description: Version and editable state are the originally committed result, not the current draft. Detail expires exactly seven days after first terminal record.

DraftOperationConflict.description: Bounded original conflict metadata, recorded atomically without changing the draft. current_version=0 and state=null only when the requested own draft was absent.

DraftOperationExpired.description: Permanent BE-02 tombstone; no retained outcome/detail exposed and this operation ID cannot execute again.

DraftOperationUnknown.description: No visible ledger record at the authorized snapshot. A save may still be in flight; never means not performed or safe to send.

ThreadReadState.description: Actor-specific desired boolean. Missing state is read=false/version=0/updated_at=null. Repeating the same desired state does not increment revision or timestamp. Concurrent differing PUTs serialize; last committed wins. No expected-version input.

ThreadAssignment.description: Unassigned initial state is null/version=0/updated_at=null. A matching-version no-op preserves revision/time; changes increment once. Stored assignee IDs may be historical after later revocation and never confer access.

ThreadNoteInput.description: Immutable plaintext note. Preserve exact content, including whitespace; no HTML/Markdown evaluation. The caller UUID is an idempotency key, not permission.

ThreadNote.description: Immutable note; version is always 1 because BE-02 has no edit/delete route. Historical author UUID is attribution, not current membership or access.

MembershipCapabilities.description: An explicit active membership itself grants mailbox read. Shared-mailbox readers need no explicit row. Flags default false in provisioning, but all three are required on PUT; no inferred send/manager permission.

MailboxMemberInput.description: expected_membership_version is the mailbox-wide revision returned by the manager list, not a per-user revision. PUT replaces all explicit capability flags.

MailboxMemberPage.description: Only explicit members still in the current organization, sorted by user_id ascending; shared effective readers are not enumerated.

MailboxMembershipResult.description: Post-write mailbox revision; member=null means no explicit membership, not necessarily no shared-mailbox read. A successful permission change may return a new actor authorization_version; re-bootstrap before using cached protected data.

SearchPage.description: One authorized result per thread using unchanged plaintext ThreadSummary. q is echoed exactly, mailbox_id=null is all currently readable mailboxes. No total counts, rank, HTML highlights or extra body access.

consent_evidence.description: True only when the server holds consent evidence for this recipient.

SendReview.description: Bounded author-owned unsent draft; invalid send addresses remain displayable. ready=false requires null review_digest; ready=true requires a digest. No suppression reason or provider content.

suppression_reason.description: Why the recipient is suppressed after a provider bounce or complaint event.

SendOutboundMode.description: Server-selected outbound transport. Under resend, every recipient needs consent evidence (Resend acceptable use policy).

ThreadFolder.description: Mailbox-shared folder of a thread. Every member of the mailbox sees the same folder; it is not actor-specific.

snoozed_until.description: null clears the snooze. A value must be at least 60 seconds and at most 366 days after the server clock, else 400 request_invalid.

ThreadFolderState.description: Mailbox-shared folder and snooze state after a folder or snooze write. A thread that never moved reports folder=inbox, snoozed_until=null, folder_version=0 and updated_at=null. Repeating the same desired state does not increment the version. Differing writes serialize; last committed wins. The version is informational, never a precondition.

ThreadStarState.description: Actor-specific star after a star write. Missing state is starred=false/version=0/updated_at=null. Repeating the same desired state is a no-op.

CdSessionContext.name: X-Session-Context
CdSessionContext.description: Current bootstrap context, never an authorization grant.

CdAuthorizationVersion.name: X-Authorization-Version
CdAuthorizationVersion.description: Current bootstrap authorization version; mismatch returns context_changed after authentication.

CdOrigin.name: Origin
CdOrigin.description: Exact configured same-origin value required on every C/D PUT, POST and DELETE. No redirect or permissive CORS.

CdCsrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
CdCsrf.description: Current session CSRF proof bound to this cookie and context. A login/refresh challenge is not accepted for C/D writes.

CdCursor.name: cursor
CdCursor.description: Signed, expiring keyset token bound to actor, organization, session context, authorization generation, route, resource IDs, filters, ordering and effective limit. Membership pages also bind membership_version. Invalid/expired/scope mismatch: 400 cursor_invalid.

CdLimit.name: limit
CdLimit.description: Single decimal integer 1..50; no signs, fractions, exponents, coercion, arrays or duplicate keys.

CdBadRequest.description: request_invalid for malformed/unknown/duplicate input, invalid UUID, missing context/CSRF/Origin, wrong content type or byte limit; cursor_invalid for invalid/expired/scope-mismatched cursor. No mutation.

CdUnauthenticated.description: unauthenticated for missing, invalid, expired or locally revoked session; takes precedence over stale context. Clear sensitive state.

CdNotAvailable.description: not_available: identical code/message for absent/foreign/inaccessible resources, wrong mailbox relation, missing required capability or an ineligible target. Message is exactly: This item is unavailable.

CdConflict.description: context_changed on valid but stale context; otherwise only the route's named draft_conflict, operation_mismatch, draft_consumed, assignment_conflict or membership_conflict. No content in errors; re-read through authorized routes.

CdRateLimited.description: rate_limited; no replay success may be inferred; optional Retry-After delta seconds 1..300.

CdUnavailable.description: temporarily_unavailable for dependency outage, deadline/lock timeout or version exhaustion; preserve edits and operation ID. Does not establish whether an earlier write committed.

CdInternalError.description: internal_error; generic bounded message/request_id, no exception, credential or mail content.

Send400.description: request_invalid; bounded generic error, no content disclosure.

Send401.description: unauthenticated; bounded generic error, no content disclosure.

Send404.description: not_available â€” This item is unavailable.

Send409.description: context_changed,review_stale,send_not_ready,draft_consumed,draft_conflict,operation_mismatch,send_terminal; bounded generic error, no content disclosure.

Send429.description: rate_limited; bounded generic error, no content disclosure.

Send503.description: temporarily_unavailable,dispatch_held; bounded generic error, no content disclosure.

Send500.description: internal_error; bounded generic error, no content disclosure.

x-csrf-policy.bootstrap: GET /v1/auth/login-challenge for lifecycle; GET /v1/session after current authentication for ordinary protected mutations.
x-csrf-policy.unsafe_requests: Exact configured Origin plus X-CSRF-Token and the route-specific session/challenge binding; refresh must accept locally valid cookies with expired access JWTs.
x-csrf-policy.sec_fetch_site: defense in depth, not a substitute for token and Origin
